title: Exponential Distribution of Normalized Prime Gaps
exact_target: If $p_n$ is the $n$th prime, then the normalized prime gaps $(p_{n+1}-p_n)/\log p_n$ should be asymptotically distributed like an exponential random variable with density $e^{-x}$ for $0\leq x<\infty$.
